deals.title: ASUS TUF Gaming B550-Plus Wi-Fi II AM4 ATX Gaming Motherboard for $116 + free 2-day shipping
deals.sourceText: B&H Photo's Holiday Savings drops the ASUS TUF Gaming B550-Plus Wi-Fi II motherboard to $116, which is $30 off and the lowest price we found by at least $4. Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.2, and 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet are built in, so no separate wireless card is needed. Free 2-day shipping is included. Buy Now at B&H Photo Video Features Works with AMD Ryzen 5000 Series processors via AM4 socket 4 DDR4 memory slots supporting up to 128GB 2 M.2 slots & 6 SATA III ports for storage Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.2, & 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet 1 PCIe 4.0 x16 slot for graphics card 3-year limited manufacturer warranty

deals.title: MSI MAG Coreliquid A13 240 240mm AIO Liquid CPU Cooler for $50 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: At Newegg, this MSI MAG Coreliquid A13 240 liquid cooler is $49.99 with free shipping. It's the best price we found by $15. The fans come pre-installed and the Intel mounting bracket is already attached, and MSI backs it with a 5-year parts and labor warranty. Shipping is free. Buy Now at Newegg Features 240mm aluminum radiator w/ two pre-installed 120mm ARGB fans Fan speed of 500 to 2000 RPM w/ 62.6 CFM airflow and 31.1 dBA noise Pump runs at 3800 RPM w/ 20 dBA average noise Fits Intel LGA 1700/1851 & AMD AM4/AM5 sockets 15.35" EPDM tubing resists coolant evaporation 5-year limited warranty on parts and labor

deals.title: DeWalt 15A Benchtop Planer & Mobile Base for $679 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: At Lowe's, this DeWalt 13" benchtop planer and mobile base set is $370 less than if you bought the items separately, and is one of Lowe's daily deals. The planer alone weighs around 92-lbs., so the included wheeled base keeps it from needing to be lifted onto a bench each time. MyLowe's Rewards members get free shipping on this order (it's free to join). Pickup may also be available. Buy Now at Lowe's Features Set includes a 13" benchtop planer and a mobile base 15-amp corded motor Planer handles boards up to 13" wide Mobile base has steel construction for heavy loads Pickup available at select stores, with delivery estimated by Nov. 13

deals.title: ASUS ROG Strix 34" UltraWide QHD HDR FreeSync OLED Monitor for $729 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: At Newegg, this ASUS ROG Strix XG34WCDMS costs $729, which is $58 less than Best Buy's price. The 3-year warranty covers burn-in and includes cross shipping, a notable protection for an OLED panel. Shipping is free. Buy Now at Newegg Features 34" curved (1800R) panel at 3440 x 1440 resolution 280Hz refresh rate with 0.03ms response time VESA DisplayHDR 500 True Black with 99% DCI-P3 color coverage Ports include DisplayPort 1.4, HDMI 2.1, and USB-C with 15W power delivery G-Sync compatible with built-in burn-in protection features 3-year warranty that covers burn-in and includes cross shipping

deals.title: DeWalt Atomic 20V MAX Li-Ion 1/4" Impact Driver Kit for $99 w/ Ace Rewards + free shipping
deals.sourceText: Ace Hardware has this DeWalt impact driver kit at $99, which is $81 off, when you sign in to an Ace Rewards account (free to join). It includes the driver, a 2Ah battery, a charger, and a belt clip. DeWalt backs it with a 3-year limited warranty. Shipping is free for rewards members, and pickup is also available. Buy Now at Ace Hardware Features 3,200 impacts per minute & 2,800 revolutions per minute 1,700 in-lbs. of torque variable speed trigger 3 LEDs Includes a battery, charger, and bag, as well as the impact driver

deals.title: LG B6 Series OLED48B6GUA 48" 4K HDR OLED UHD Smart TV for $600 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: As an Early Black Friday deal, Best Buy offers the LG B6 OLED 48" TV for $600. That's half price, and $200 under our mention from September. The 48" OLED panel supports a 120Hz refresh rate and a 0.1ms response time, along with NVIDIA G-Sync and AMD FreeSync Premium for gaming. My Best Buy members get free shipping on all orders (it's free to join). Buy Now at Best Buy Features 48" OLED display with 4K resolution Over 8.3 million self-lit pixels for deep black levels 120Hz native refresh rate with VRR support Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, and FILMMAKER MODE 4 HDMI 2.1 inputs for gaming and streaming devices Runs LG's webOS 26 smart TV platform

deals.title: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 Ryzen 7 8840HS 15.3" Laptop w/ 512GB SSD for $599 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: This Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 pairs a Ryzen 7 8840HS processor with 16GB of memory and a 512GB drive for $599 at Walmart. Other Walmart listings for the same Ryzen 7 8840HS configuration run from $870 to $940. Rapid Charge adds about 2 hours of use from a 15-minute charge. Shipping is free on this order, too. Buy Now at Walmart Features AMD Ryzen 7 8840HS processor 16GB of memory 512GB solid state drive 15.3" WUXGA IPS display with 16:10 aspect ratio AMD Radeon 780M graphics Windows 11 Home with a manual webcam privacy shutter

deals.title: Anker Solix C1000X Gen2 1,024Wh Portable Power Station for $500 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: The Anker SOLIX C1000X Gen2 power station is $500 off at Best Buy, with the deal ending tonight. It delivers 2,000W of continuous output through 9 ports, and the battery holds at least 80% capacity after 4,000 charge cycles. My Best Buy members get free shipping on all orders (it's free to join). Buy Now at Best Buy Features 1,024Wh battery capacity 2,000W continuous output, 3,000W peak 9 output ports Recharges fully in 49 minutes with the Anker app's fast-charge mode Under 10 ms UPS switchover for devices like CPAP machines Rated for 4,000 charge cycles with at least 80% capacity remaining
